exercises.hint: Use an index as your cursor position. while True: fetch rows[i], break when the index runs past the end (%NOTFOUND), then 'close' with a final print.
exercises.solution:
rows = [1, 2, 3]

# OPEN c
pos = 0
while True:
    # FETCH c INTO v
    if pos >= len(rows):
        break  # EXIT WHEN c%NOTFOUND
    print('fetched: ' + str(rows[pos]))
    pos += 1
# CLOSE c
print('cursor closed')
